subject: Post-demo: Buying committee recap & procurement path
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@finservcorp.com>, Mike Chan <mike.chan@finservcorp.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo: Buying committee recap & procurement path

Thanks again for taking the hour today — great conversation. Quick recap from our demo and proposed next steps so we can keep momentum with the buying committee. I listed the stakeholder map and the asks we heard from your side.

Demo highlights (30 min):
- Live throughput demo of Gen-2 model family (target latency ~80ms for 256-token responses).
- Prefix caching and auto-batching demo showing expected cost reduction ~30% on baseline workload.
- RBAC and VPC/private deployment options for regulated data.

Stakeholder map (from today):
- Economic buyer: Mike Chan — will own budget and ROI sign-off.
- Security reviewer: Lena Ortiz — will lead SOC2/DPA review and dataflow questions.
- Procurement: procurement@finservcorp.com — will handle PO/contract redlines and SOW.
- Engineering owner (not present): you mentioned an infra lead who will validate the VPC deployment pattern.

Decision criteria you called out:
1) Security/compliance (SOC2 + DPA)
2) Predictable latency and 99.9% uptime SLA
3) Unit economics (cost per 1M tokens and predictable billing)
4) Ease of integration (SDKs + per-route observability)

Requested deliverables (I will own delivery by EOD Wed 24 Mar unless you ask otherwise):
- SOC2 Type II summary + SOC scope + short controls mapping (attached: redwood-soc2-type2-summary.pdf).
- Dataflow diagram and brief on data-in-flight/encryption (attached: dataflow-diagram.svg).
- Tailored pricing spreadsheet and sample committed throughput option (attached: redwood-pricing-2026-03.pdf).
- Draft SOW and standard terms for your procurement/legal to review (I will push a draft DocuSign link).

Next steps we propose:
- Mar 23 (Tue) 10:00–10:30 PT: Security deep-dive with Lena + your infra lead (30m).
- Mar 24 (Wed) 11:00–11:30 PT: Procurement + legal to review draft SOW and commercial terms.
- Target internal decision: week of Mar 30.

Please confirm if the stakeholder map above is correct or add other names I should include. I’ll follow up with the attachments and the HubSpot/DocuSign links.

Thanks,
Marissa
Senior Solutions Lead | Redwood Inference

[Attachment: redwood-soc2-type2-summary.pdf (PDF, 220KB)]

From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@finservcorp.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Mike Chan <mike.chan@finservcorp.com>, procurement@finservcorp.com
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: Buying committee recap & procurement path

Marissa — thanks for the clear recap and for sending those assets. A few quick notes from security: we need the following to start the internal security review checklist (please send by EOD Wed if possible):
1) SOC2 Type II: full attestation PDF or link to the auditor report (the summary is useful but we need the cert).
2) Dataflow diagram with redaction/PHI flags annotated (your SVG is a good start, but we need explicit handling for persistent storage and delete retention).
3) Encryption details: KMS/HSM usage, key rotation policy, and whether customer-managed keys are supported.
4) Proof-of-isolation for Private/VPC deployments (network diagram and what is shared with control plane).

Also: legal/procurement will ask for a standard DPA and the last 12 months of incident history (high level redacted timeline). We can start an internal security meeting on Tue 23 at 10:00 PT — I invited our infra lead (Amit Shah) and Security Ops. If you can be on that call, we can walk through the dataflow and the controls mapping.

Best,
Lena Ortiz
Head of Security 
FinServCorp
[Attachment: finserv-security-questions.xlsx (XLSX, 110KB)]
From: Mike Chan <mike.chan@finservcorp.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@finservcorp.com>
Cc: procurement@finservcorp.com
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2026 13:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: Buying committee recap & procurement path

Quick note from the budget side — appreciated the demo. High level: we like what we saw. My asks to make this fast for procurement:
- Can Redwood commit to a latency SLA (p99) or provide performance profiles for hosted vs. dedicated options? We need numbers to include in the procurement packet.
- Please include cost delta for a 12-month commitment vs pay-as-you-go (we are modeling a 2–3x throughput seasonality).
- ROI ask: show cost per resolved customer interaction assuming 150 tokens per interaction.

If you can provide the SLA language and the committed pricing by Wed EOD, procurement has a shot at turning this into a PO by the week of Mar 30. I’m looping Procurement on this thread.

Thanks,
Mike Chan
VP, Digital Products | FinServCorp
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Mike Chan <mike.chan@finservcorp.com>, Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@finservcorp.com>, procurement@finservcorp.com
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2026 14:48:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: Buying committee recap & procurement path

Thanks — all good items. Short update on the actions and where we’ll land: 
- SLA/performance profile: I attached a one-page performance profile and will include an explicit p99 latency SLA clause in the draft SOW (hosted: p99 target 120ms under standard traffic; dedicated: p99 target 60–90ms depending on GPU config).
- Committed pricing vs PAYG: attached pricing includes a committed 12-month column and a PAYG column. I’ll add a sample cost model for 150 tokens/interactions and call out the cost-per-resolved-interaction metric.
- Security docs: I will upload the full SOC2 Type II attestation link and the detailed controls mapping by EOD Wed. Dev is looping in our private deployment engineer to prepare the VPC isolation diagram for the call on Tue.

Proposed next items (confirm/timebox):
- Tue Mar 23, 10:00 PT: Security deep-dive (Lena + Amit + Redwood infra engineer).
- Wed Mar 24, 11:00 PT: Procurement commercial review (we will have draft SOW + SLA + pricing).

HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/FIN-2026-0319-REDWOOD
DocuSign (draft SOW will be pushed): https://www.docusign.com/instance/abcdef123456

If that looks right I’ll lock the invites and push the DocuSign draft.

Cheers,
Marissa
Senior Solutions Lead | Redwood Inference
